statement: The appendices of arxiv:2609.12230 do NOT contain the control that gap G001 requires: there is no arm in which context slots are filled with random or unrelated triples at a matched token budget during training, and the only context-volume manipulation is an inference-time threshold sweep on 1-hop QA with the frozen base model. The sweep's accuracy is non-monotone in the mean number of context triples (accuracy peaks at intermediate thresholds and falls at the loosest and strictest settings), which is inconsistent with a naive 'more context tokens is better' story but is not a substitute for a matched-token irrelevant-context training arm, because the threshold changes relevance and volume simultaneously and acts at inference rather than during fine-tuning.
